purpose: cross-wave judge ledger: one entry per judged campaign so verdicts, gaps and prompt improvements form a hillclimb gradient instead of isolated greens
append_only: each entry carries prev_sha256 = sha256 over the canonical JSON of the previous entry (genesis = 64 zeros); head_sha256 is the digest of the last entry. Appending extends the chain without touching prior bytes; removing or rewriting any entry fails the validator. This producer additionally refuses to regenerate a ledger.json that would drop or rewrite a previously written entry - see check_prefix_preserved in this file.
